exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section or vaginal)
Unilateral posterior pelvic pain provocation test (P4) result
Active straight leg raise (ASLR) test score
outcome: Prevalence of pelvic girdle pain (PGP) postpartum
finding: Caesarean delivery, ASLR test score ≥4, positive unilateral P4 test, and sitting position during breastfeeding were associated with an increased risk of PGP during the first three months postpartum.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of pelvic girdle pain postpartum (adjusted OR 2.0, 95% CI 1.3-4.9).
